policy.natural_earth_use: geography_and_cartography_only; never a source for WP1.5 statistics or classifications
policy.observation_scope: one current observation per country and statistic; retain source reference period and distinguish observed, estimated, projected, unavailable, and not_applicable
policy.missing_values: never infer or fill; explicit unavailable/not_applicable may be stored as NULL with status; absent rows remain missing for the final completeness audit
policy.raw_data_version_control: local_only; track manifests, URLs, retrieval timestamps, release identifiers, and SHA-256 checksums in Git
policy.source_status: candidate sources require field-level coverage, definitions, update cadence, download format, and terms verification before production acquisition
